title: ActionProjectionV1
description: Bounded projection of receipt_actions for actions.jsonl export. Does not contain raw input, result or error text.

record_version.description: Record schema version, always 1 for v1 export

pre_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the pre-action receipt (null until pre append)

terminal_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the terminal receipt (null until post/refusal)

recovery_code.description: Bounded recovery code (present only for pending_recovery state)

requires_reconciliation.description: True when action requires manual reconciliation

approval_id.description: Approval intent UUID (null when approval_state is 'none')

approval_call_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the approved call bytes

tool_args_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of tool arguments

created_at_ms.description: Creation timestamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch

updated_at_ms.description: Last update timestamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch
